plans.idea: Classic centred vertical stack that mirrors the original: brand mark on top, tall phone centred with the NEW FLAVOR sticker hanging off its upper-right shoulder, then headline and subhead, then a contained CTA button with breathing room below.

Message-first story: logo then headline and subhead lead at the top, the phone fills the lower middle with the sticker tucked at its upper-left, and the CTA anchors the bottom so the read runs brand to headline to product to action.

Product-hero poster: the phone owns the top half at full scale with the sticker on its corner, headline and subhead sit beneath, the CTA follows, and the logo closes the column as a quiet bottom sign-off.
